# MidiPipe Release Notes
## V2.2.1 2026-11-09
- fix window sizing issue (found by Gabriele)
## V2.2.0 2026-11-08
- New Message Converter tool (rewritten in Swift, this also fixes an UI issue seen in recent macOS versions reported by Torley)
## V2.1.0 2026-11-06
- Automatic updates with Sparkle via secure HTTPS (Check for update in the MidiPipe menu) - New MIDI Out tool (rewritten in Swift) - Translation fixes (German, French, Italian)
## V2.0.2 2026-01-25
- Fix SysEx output in AList tool (reported by Johannes)
## V2.0.1 2025-12-23
- Fix crash during endless loop detection - Fix passthrough of Timing Clock tool
## V2.0.0 2025-06-23
- Add tool "Timing Clock" (requested by Anton) - require macOS 12.0 or higher
## V1.9.0 2025-04-28
- Add Timeout parameter to "Double Filter" tool (requested by Gerard)
## V1.8.6 2025-03-29
- Fix "Keyboard" output channel bug (found by Gabriele)
## V1.8.5 2025-03-27
- Fix "MicroTuner" scale view visual bug (found by Gabriele)
## V1.8.4 2025-03-04
- Fix "Randomizer does not handle note on with velocity 0 correctly" bug (found by Gabriele)
## V1.8.3 2025-03-02
- Fix "Save As… to same folder" bug (reported by Michael)
## V1.8.2 2025-01-30
- Add preference option "do not restart MIDI" (needed by Greg)
## V1.8.1 2025-01-26
- Fix bug in "Control Split" tool related to min value of limit option when invert option is enabled
## V1.8.0 2024-07-22
- added "CurveTransformer" tool - transform any parameter value along a Bézier curve (requested by Robert)
## V1.7.3 2024-06-08
- call MIDIRestart after endpoint hijack changes (requested by Jeremy)
## V1.7.2 2023-09-06
- Fix offline port detection (reported by Gabriele)
## V1.7.1 2023-08-24
- Set MIDIUniqueID of virtual MIDIEndpoints (reported by Robert)
## V1.7.0 2023-06-30
- added "Toggle" tool - toggle between two defined values (inspired by Gabriele) - require macOS 11.0 or higher
## V1.6.3 2021-12-25
- Fix "Virtual Input/Output" panel in Dark Mode (reported by Robert) - Fix sporadic crash caused by AList tool
## V1.6.2 2021-04-04
- Fix octave display if preference option "Middle C" is set to "C4" or "C3" (reported by Joris)
## V1.6.1 2020-12-23
- Do not hide panels when inactive (requested by Paul) - Fix "Update available" information in Dark Mode
## V1.6.0 2020-11-16
- add native support for arm64 (Apple M1)
## V1.5.7 2020-10-25
- add "Andrews DoubleNoteFilter.mipi" to Example Pipes folded (thanks to Andrew) - fix Donation URL (thanks to Stefan)
## V1.5.6 2019-10-04
- disable code signing
## V1.5.5 2019-07-31
- Fix startup crash when new version is available (reported by Tomasz)
## V1.5.4 2019-05-26
- Correctly handle identical named ports in MIDI In and MIDI Out tool (reported by Sebastian)
## V1.5.3 2019-04-20
- fix virtual ports staying offline
## V1.5.2 2019-04-20
- fix MIDI output tool connecting to wrong port (reported by Mark)
## V1.5.1 2019-02-20
- add support for macOS Sierra 10.12 (requested by Juan) - fix macOS 10.14 Dark Mode
## V1.5.0 2019-01-27
- MidiPipe is now a 64-bit app and requires macOS High Sierra 10.13 or higher - fixed "side effect" bug in multiple tools - fixed bug related to handling of large SysEx messages (reported by Toni, David) - fixed window tab issued (reported by Mike) - fixed sporadic main window sizing issue - adapted "Keyboard" tool scroll bar changes - updated app icon
## V1.4.6 2012-05-05
- fix main window sizing issue in when German language is used
## V1.4.5 2012-05-03
- point version check URL to new location, due to planned end of MobileMe on 06/30/2012
## V1.4.4 2011-12-31
- fixed bug that caused hijacked ports to not get unhihjacked at app quit under Mac OS X 10.6 and later (reported by Axel)
## V1.4.3 2007-12-15
- fixed bug in "Midi In" tool related to opening pipes with hijacked inputs which are currently not connected (reported by Nik) - fixed bug in "Message Converter" tool related to display of output CC's > 119 (reported by Gauthier) - Plugin Example project now creates Universal plugins and uses correct file extension ".plugin" - moved development to Xcode 3.0 (Leopard) -- Mac OS X 10.2.9 not supported anymore
## V1.4.2 2007-05-29
- fixed bug related to panel windows
## V1.4.1 2006-03-07
- added French localisation (thanks to Richard) - fixed bug in "MIDI Loop Protection" when more than one "MIDI Out" tool was used
## V1.4.0 2006-01-11
- added "Monophonic" tool - make monophonic (requested by Wheat) - extended "Velocity Modifier" tool to allow filtering (requested by Wheat) - extended "Message Factory" tool to support all System Messages as trigger (requested by Chris) - added useful presets to "Key Mapper" tool (Reset, Inverse, Filter All)
## V1.3.6 2005-11-15
- extended "Message Factory" tool to support System Exclusive as trigger and trigger message as data source (requested by oink) - fixed bug in "AppleScript Trigger" that prevented returning multi-messages (ex. return {144,0,64,145,64,64}) - added Plugin API for developers to create their own tools (BETA - please send me feedback) - added Universal Binary to run on Intel architecture (not tested - please send me feedback)
## V1.3.1 08/22/2005
- moved development to Xcode 2.1 (Tiger) and fixed Tiger related bugs - added "Double Filter" tool - filters identical messages - updated Italian localisation (thanks to Claudio) - "Message Converter" tool now applies it's options even if input and output settings are the same - made main window resizable
## V1.2.0 2005-05-06
- added "MIDISend" AppleScript command - send MIDI messages from your AppleScripts to MidiPipe (requested by Jim) - made "AppleScript Trigger" panel resizable (requested by Matt) - fixed bug in "AppleScript Trigger" that caused returned messages to have a wrong time stamp (reported by Matt)
## V1.1.0 2005-04-05
- added "Message Factory" tool - trigger your own messages with static and variable data bytes (requested by Rjahn) - enhanced "Transpose" tool - multiple keys, set velocity, delay and channel
## V1.0.2 2005-03-05
- fixed bug in "AppleScript Trigger" that prevented script properties to stick under Mac OS X 10.3 (reported by John) - removed "Message Factory" tool from tool list, because it is not finished yet (showed up by mistake)
## V1.0.1 2005-02-20
- added "hijack" option to "Midi In" tool - this makes the selected port invisible to other apps (use with GarageBand or Logic Express) - added workaround to make "AppleScript Trigger" work under Mac OS X 10.2 again (bug reported by Metallbau) - virtual ports can be renamed now - added "Duplicate Tool" and "Duplicate Pipe" menu items (requested by stabilizer)
## V0.9.9 (beta) 2004-12-20
- minor interface changes to make localisation easier - added Italian (thank you Claudio) and German localisation
## V0.9.8 (beta) 2004-10-17
- added "DLS Synth" tool - user interface for Apple's DLS Synth - fixed key repeat problem in Keyboard tool - fixed comment field in SMF Player
## V0.9.7 (beta) 2004-10-11
- added C4 to preference option "Middle C" (requested by Tim) - added a "highlight" option to Keyboard tool (requested by Kent)
## V0.9.6 (beta) 2004-09-05
- added "Key Mapper" tool (requested by PhotoKev) - added preference option "Middle C" to choose between C5 (MidiPipe default) and C3 (requested by p8guitar) - fixed another incompatibility with Mac OS X 10.2 when loading a saved pipe
## V0.9.5 (beta) 2004-07-17
- added "SMF Player" tool - plays up to 128 MIDI Files; handles Song Select, Start/Stop/Continue messages - added "Save" to the file menu - "MicroTuner" tool now uses channel 1 to 9 and 11 to 13 (skips channel 10 which some synths reserve for drum kit)
## V0.9.4 (beta) 2004-06-10
- fixed incompatibility with Mac OS X 10.2 when loading a saved pipe - added preference panel with "hide after launch" option
## V0.9.3 (beta) 2004-05-20
- fixed crash bug when opening a tool panel of a saved pipe
## V0.9.2 (beta) 2004-05-18
- finally added multiple pipe support for cleaner "midipiping" - added "MIDI Loop Protection" to avoid system hangs - fixed crash bug caused by "AppleScript Trigger" tool (reported by Aleatoric) - fixed "settings get loaded and work but aren't shown" bug in "Keyboard" tool - fixed minor bug in "Control Slider" tool - "MicroTuner" tool now replicates all channel messages (except pitchbend) to channel 1 to 12
## V0.9.1 (beta) 2004-04-03
- now handles changes in MIDI environment correctly (affects Midi In and Midi Out tool) - added support for "User Scales" to "MicroTuner" tool
## V0.8.4 (beta) 2004-03-04
- added support for RPN/NRPNs to "Message Converter" tool - fixed "settings get loaded and work but aren't shown" bug in "MicroTuner" tool
## V0.8.2 (beta) 2004-02-18
- added "Velocity Modifier" tool - reduced latency of virtual inputs - fixed "panel not closing" bug in "AList" tool - fixed bug which prevented several tool settings from saving correctly
## V0.7.7 (beta) 2004-01-29
- "Pitchbend Test" button in "MicroTuner" tool now works - fixed bug in "Control Split" tool - fixed memory leak bug in "AppleScript Trigger" tool - improved "AList" tool slightly
## V0.7.4 (beta) 2004-01-22
- moved development to Xcode (Panther) - generally optimised MIDI message handling (lower latency) - now tools can be disabled for temporarily turning them off without loosing their settings (requested by Julean) - fixed bugs in "Keyboard" tool - added "(N)RPN Mapper" tool - "AppleScript Trigger" tool now passes MIDI message to script and script can return a message which is placed in the pipe
## V0.6.2 (beta) 2003-05-28
- added "AppleScript Trigger" tool (requested by Christopher) - fixed bug in auto-update-check routine that caused unexpected quit during launch in rare situations
## V0.6.1 (beta) 2003-05-19
- added "Control Slider" tool (requested by Bill) - fixed bug in "Keyboard" tool which caused missing Note Offs in some cases and the "Delay" tool to have no effect (reported by Larry)
## V0.5.5 (beta) 2003-04-30
- added visualisation for "MicroTuner" tool -- now see what you should hear :-) - workaround for a bug that generated unexpected results if running status was supported in receiving device (reported by David)
## V0.5.4 (beta) 2003-04-17
- added "Control Split" tool (was requested by Marc) - added hexadecimal format in AList tool (was requested by Brian) - added "Bank Select" to named Controller list (was requested by Brian also) - bug fixed in version check part of pipe load routine (don't go backwards and try to load 0.5.4 pipes into 0.5.3)
## V0.5.3 (beta) 2003-01-27
- added Save support (finally) - added "Use Note Off Velocity" option (turned off by default) to fix "hanging notes" caused by devices not supporting it - hopefully fixed bug causing startup delay when internet is enabled but not available (used for automatic update check)
## V0.4.1 (beta) 2002-11-27
- added Set tool - added Duration tool (to make Greg's life easier :) - added "Clear List" button to AList tool (was requested by Greg :) - added automatic check for updated version - fixed bug in Pitch Wheel part of Randomizer; MSB/LSB were swapped -- oops! - fixed problems related to Note On messages with velocity at 0 -- are now handled as Note Off in every tool
## V0.4.0 (beta) 2002-11-12
- added Keyboard tool - use as input to play with mouse/keyboard or as a output to watch note on/off messages - added MicroTuner tool - routes notes to channel 1-12 and applies pitch-bend data in order to create different scales
## V0.3.2 (beta) 2002-11-06
- added Randomizer tool (was requested by pherin :) - fixed small bug related to 'Message Converter' 'Control Change' buttons - removed resize buttons from panels - minor change in double click behaviour of "Tools" list: selection doesn't jump to "Pipe" list after tool is added
## V0.3.1 (beta) 2002-09-08
- removed: "Latency in ns" column in "AList", since it doesn't work :-) - added a note to "Delay" tool, since it doesn't work with some devices is sent through a virtual output in MidiPipe - added new tool "Keyboard Split" - "AList" will print note/octave and controller names now
## V0.3 (beta) 2002-09-05
- initial release
